records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Theo,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, North Works
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Account created first project on day 4 unprompted (facts), showing real activity, but no invites sent and no reply to three Wrenfield emails (email:22a8331b, email:bc6f9691, email:d979bf57), no tickets. Solo Starter user with 8 days left: some chance of self-serve activation, but engagement signals are weak.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Nice work getting North Works' first project set up. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the usual next step is getting your real work in there alongside the people who'll own it. Whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through how you've structured things and suggest what to add next.

Best,
Chidi
